title: China Gravel Bike vs. Mountain Bike Single Track – WILL IT BREAK? *YOELEO ALTERA G21

takeaways.text: Ran Pirelli 700×50C tires (the presenter also called them 51 mm) without reported rub; the video does not measure remaining clearance.

A road-focused, roughly 90 kg rider took it on beginner-to-intermediate singletrack at 27–28 psi; he judged the bike capable and fun, with his own skills and the drop bar as the limits. No frame damage or faults were reported.
Quoted as roughly US$2,600 retail for the frameset with wheels, bar and seatpost in August 2025; the presenter offers a discount code.

disclosure: The description links the frameset with the creator's discount code; the video does not state how it was obtained.
summary: Mountain-bike singletrack test of a G21 build on 700×50 tires alongside full-suspension bikes, with remarks on capability, storage and price.
